title: UW Markdown Lease-Up Schedule Section
description: Content payload for the `lease_up_schedule` section (UW_FORMAT_SPEC_v1.md §4.25, RFC 0008). A period-by-period trajectory from current to stabilized rents: a `model_type`, a uniform `period_granularity`, the driving `assumptions`, the `schedule` array, and a `stabilized_summary`. This is a state-and-verify structure (RFC 0021 §6, the `capital_stack` precedent): the Tier-3 calc engine never reads it, so a variable-length period array is safe, and every stated aggregate is recomputed by `verifyLeaseUpSchedule` rather than trusted. This schema enforces structure only. The cross-field rules a validator/verifier adds are: the period grammar and granularity uniformity (LU-01); strictly-increasing gap-free periods (LU-02); a non-empty schedule whose stabilization_target is not before it starts (LU-03); natural_turnover with no rent_roll in the document (LU-04, warning); the base variant's stabilized NOI within tolerance of noi_model (CC-15, warning); and each period's stated net_cash_flow recomputing from its components or the result is `failed`.

_meta.description: Standard block provenance envelope (§2.5). Not constrained here.

model_type.description: `natural_turnover` = an occupied asset re-leasing at market through turnover (value-add); `absorption_curve` = filling vacant or newly-built space (ground-up / lease-up of new construction). Gates nothing structurally: natural_turnover with no rent_roll is LU-04 (warning), not a refusal.

period_granularity.description: The schedule's cadence, uniform per schedule. Every `period` uses this granularity's grammar (LU-01).

stabilization_target.description: The period by which the deal is underwritten to stabilize, in the declared granularity's grammar. MUST NOT be earlier than the first schedule period (LU-03).

assumptions.description: The assumption set driving the trajectory — the deal thesis, never defaultable background (nothing here enters the cascade tables). Rates are fractions (0.04 = 4%).

monthly_turnover_rate.description: Fraction of units/space turning per month (natural_turnover).

market_rent_psf_at_stabilization.description: Underwritten market rent per SF at the stabilization target.

vacancy_during_lease_up.description: Average vacancy carried through the lease-up window, as a fraction.

concession_months_per_lease.description: Free-rent months granted per new lease.

leasing_commission_rate.description: LC as a fraction of lease value.

schedule.description: The stated trajectory, one entry per period, strictly increasing and gap-free (LU-02). Stated data, not formulas: the calc engine never iterates it; specific cells remain addressable by path (e.g. `lease_up_schedule.schedule[5].rent_revenue`).

stabilized_summary.description: The stated endpoint. `occupied_sf` and `occupancy_rate` are verified against the final period (the rate through the Protocol §XIII size denominator); `annualized_noi` cross-checks `noi_model` within LEASE_UP_STABILIZED_TOLERANCE (CC-15).

period.description: One period of the trajectory. Dollar figures are period totals; rates are fractions. A period stating `net_cash_flow` without all three components is `unverifiable` for that row, never wrong.

occupied_sf.description: Physically occupied SF at period end.

leased_sf.description: Leased SF at period end (leased ≥ occupied during free-rent periods).

concessions.description: Period concessions, stated as a negative number.

ti_lc_capex.description: Period TI/LC capital, stated as a negative number.

net_cash_flow.description: Stated period net: verified as rent_revenue + concessions + ti_lc_capex at the currency quantum.
